crossRefs.note: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house…
Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together…
Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away…

translations.web: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,
translations.bsb: If there is a virgin pledged in marriage to a man, and another man encounters her in the city and sleeps with her,
translations.kjv: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie
translations.asv: If there be a damsel that is a virgin betrothed unto a husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie with her;
